answer: Reputation Ripple Ledger. Each identity's task receipts form a ridge of history that earns fee discounts and priority matching. A new clone starts at zero history and pays full fees plus a cold-start deposit held against its first five tasks. Because rewards scale with accumulated receipts, fabricating k clones yields k cold-start deposits and zero carried reputation, so the marginal clone's expected payoff stays below its deposit. Honest operators reuse one meadow of history; attackers must fund fresh deposits per identity, making each clone strictly negative-EV.
